title: Optimal-rate regret bound for Hedge
statement:
Consider the Hedge algorithm run against a valid loss sequence for $N > 1$ experts over $T \ge 1$ rounds, so that every individual loss lies in $[0,1]$. If the learning rate is set to the tight optimal value $\eta_{\mathrm{tight}} = \sqrt{8\ln N / T}$, then the regret against the best expert in hindsight satisfies
\[
  R_T(\eta_{\mathrm{tight}}) \;\le\; \sqrt{\tfrac{T}{2}\,\ln N}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: loss sequence is valid: every loss lies in [0,1]
learning rate chosen as η_tight = √(8 ln N / T)
